remarks: Hurry to see this New Canaan charmer! Custom designed and meticulously maintained by the same family for 30 years this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom ranch is handsomely sited on a beautiful, level 1-acre lot with lovely landscaping. With an impressive floor plan, this spacious home offers wonderful rooms for every lifestyle-whether relaxing, working, playing, studying, or gathering with family. Take your choice: Great Room, Library/Office, Sitting Room, or Recreation Room. Three generously proportioned bedrooms and three full bathrooms provide ample space for gracious living, remote work, and relaxation. As a bonus, there is an in-law suite on the lower level. A beautiful home with classic New England character and the essential modern amenities needed for today's living. Located in New Canaan, known for its top-rated schools, exceptional library, community amenities, fine shopping and restaurants, plus easy access to the Merritt Parkway and Metro-North.
